description: This file defines the Smarty_Internal_Compile_Private_ForeachSection class, which implements the compilation logic for {foreach} {section} tags in the Smarty templating engine. It contains methods to scan template source for relevant tag attributes, build regular expressions to match properties, and generate PHP code for Smarty variables related to foreach/section constructs.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Private_ForeachSection
classes.description: Class that handles compilation of Smarty {foreach} and {section} tags, including parsing tag attributes, scanning template source for relevant properties, and generating PHP code to support template features.

methods.name: scanForProperties
methods.description: Analyzes tag attributes to build regex patterns for matching properties in template sources.

methods.name: buildPropertyPreg
methods.description: Constructs the regular expression pattern used to identify specific Smarty tag properties within source code.

methods.name: matchProperty
methods.description: Uses the constructed regex to find property matches within a given source string.

methods.name: matchTemplateSource
methods.description: Searches the current template source for tag properties.

methods.name: matchParentTemplateSource
methods.description: Searches parent templates for tag properties, enabling inheritance-aware parsing.

methods.name: matchBlockSource
methods.description: Method stub for matching {block} tag sources, currently empty.

methods.name: compileSpecialVariable
methods.description: Generates PHP code to access Smarty variables like {$smarty.foreach.xxx} or {$smarty.section.xxx}.
